name: Halla and Rusk: practice bout
description: Controlled practice with blunted weapons, first three clean touches, stop after touch. No damaging follow-through. Player Halla chooses own actions and defences. Resolve skill exchanges with engine; touches and training effects do not cause HP damage. Both consented. Halla sized Rusk up with Perception 63 roll 9 success: Rusk stands right foot forward, sword on that side, shield tucked across left ribs; front knee exposed beneath shield.
